proportion_review.status: Narrow prototype rejected; revised specimen-informed proportions visually reviewed by integration lead before full sweep
proportion_review.prototype: 0.36 mm wire, 2.36–2.46 mm OD coil over40.3–72.45 mm active length. All dimensions were clearance-driven estimates, not source-supported proportions.
proportion_review.manufacturer_application: CAHSA primary catalog maps1994 F1504.9 toFO149/F4TZ9A758M; Pioneer primary catalog maps1992–96 4.9 toCA-8806/F4TZ9A758M. Neither establishes exact production dimensions or owner-installed identity.
proportion_review.visual_observation_from_integration_lead: Root directly viewed FO149 manufacturer photo in IAB tab52: substantial exposed compression coil around extended engine-end stem, long black socket/stem section comparable to spring length, bulky snap-in bracket retainer; coil modestly wider than moving stem and several times sheath width. Worker direct image inspection pending screenshot handoff. Worker subsequently directly inspected both full-resolution copies and confirmed topology.
proportion_review.decision: Replace short ball cup/long tiny coil with source-informed relative topology; propose isolated larger aperture/seat revision instead of optimizing only for inherited guessed bracket.

direct_specimen_observations: Both images show a long black socket/terminal stem at the moving end, terminating in a transverse ball receiver.
The exposed compression coil overlaps an extended guide/stem; it is not a thin spring on an otherwise bare long core.
The fixed end has a substantial flange and outward snap-retainer features.
Pioneer detail shows a lighter-colored fixed guide within the coil and a darker moving guide entering the opposite end. Exact internal cross-section and retention remain hidden.

The moving black section and exposed spring have comparable axial lengths. Coil OD is close to/slightly greater than the stem OD and several times the sheath OD. These are visual proportions, not dimensions or precision pixel measurements.
Neither image supplies a dimensional scale, installed preload or sufficient evidence to identify actual spring rate, material or precise turn count.

coordinated_revision_proposal.classification: All dimensions and turn count inferred; relative form informed by compared specimens. Clearance is tested after choosing proportions.
coordinated_revision_proposal.unverified_internal_construction: Spherical articulation and insert-retained guide are educational mechanisms for physical movement, not observed Ford internals.
